speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are an adolescent presenting with delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history suggestive of bone fragility. To begin my evaluation, can you tell me your current age and the specific nature of the physical features you have noticed?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (likely 21-hydroxylase deficiency) presenting with salt-wasting or simple virilizing forms, causing ambiguous genitalia, delayed puberty, and potential osteoporosis due to androgen excess.
